{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Math

|descr= Convert {{Color|red|R}}{{Color|green|G}}{{Color|blue|B}}{{Color|grey|A}} hexcode color into RGBA array format.

|s1= [hexString] call [[BIS_fnc_HEXtoRGB]]

|p1= hexString: [[String]] - string representing '''4 bytes''' of HEX color

|r1= [[Array]] format [[Color|Color (RGBA)]] - array of '''4''' numbers in range 0..1

|x1= <sqf>["025D00FF"] call BIS_fnc_HEXtoRGB; // [0.007843, 0.843138, 0, 1]</sqf>

|x2= Usually HEX code is represented as 3 bytes without alpha, so you can add it yourself:
<sqf>
_hexstring = "025D00";
[_hexString + "FF"] call BIS_fnc_HEXtoRGB; // add alpha 4th byte
</sqf>

|seealso= [[Color|Color (RGBA)]] [[BIS_fnc_colorConfigToRGBA]] [[BIS_fnc_colorRGBAtoHTML]] [[BIS_fnc_colorRGBtoHTML]] [[BIS_fnc_colorRGBAtoTexture]]
}}
